criteria.statement: `OFFLINE-FINDINGS.md` exists and records the commits measured, per-rule and complete-procedure coverage for the Academy Manufactor/Esix and Necropotence cases, the unchanged-input stratum size, the ten re-snapshotted cases with review provenance, and the staleness and coverage results
The evidence trace run from the baseline-writing revision (or, if unavailable, this checkout with the reason stated) reproduces `baseline.json` hit and miss, recorded in the findings
`npm run eval:rules-staleness` and `npm run eval:rules-coverage` have been run and their results recorded in the findings
Both manifests are committed and arm B's revision id is frozen with its recorded observations
Every paid phase was dry-run (no key, no network) and `RUNBOOK.md` records call counts and dollar estimates with each rate's check date
`RUNBOOK.md` exists, covers Phases 1 to 5 with owner inputs (cap per phase, judge model) and decisions D0 to D5, and states no paid phase was run in the build
REQ-226 to REQ-230 are present in `PRD/sections/functional-requirements.md` and REQ-185 to REQ-189 and NFR-018 are amended as the finalized proposal says, with both owner edits honoured
The `system-map.md` answer-quality summary no longer says results are only merged per case, and `worked-solutions/README.md` describes experiment runs, trace, arms and manifests
A grep over `PRD/sections/` finds no `--subject`, no new `DEC-` id, and no REQ id above REQ-230 added by this package
A test or grep shows no gate script or CI workflow invokes `eval:answer-quality`, its compare command, or the trace commands
A dated observation confirms no live OpenAI call, data refresh, or Scryfall fetch occurred during the build
